estafeta_mx.search_window: No separate tracer deadline was stated in the checked support page. Use the selected service contract.
estafeta_mx.search_actor: Sender or recipient may review tracking; service reports and re-routing options depend on the shipment.
search_documents: Tracking/guide number; Estafeta support page accepts the published guide formats.
estafeta_mx.claim_window: For damage/theft: report within 2 business days after delivery. For other incidents, including a missing shipment, the page says 30 calendar days from collection. Check the purchased service contract.
estafeta_mx.claim_actor: Sender; Estafeta says indemnity procedures are carried out by the sender.
claim_documents: Invoice for contents
Proof of shipment
Other documents requested for the case
estafeta_mx.insurance_note: Coverage is conditional on the purchased service/optional insurance. The Estafeta page describes distinct insured and uninsured cases; confirm the shipment's contract.
estafeta_mx.source_name: Estafeta indemnity process and tracking support

dhl_mx.search_window: No public missing-package tracer window verified for the Mexico DHL service in the checked sources.
dhl_mx.search_actor: Sender or recipient can check the relevant DHL business-unit tracking page; reference formats differ by unit.
search_documents: Shipment tracking number or a reference accepted by the relevant DHL business unit.
dhl_mx.claim_window: No Mexico-specific claim deadline verified in the checked public sources. Ask the DHL business unit and use the shipment contract.
dhl_mx.claim_actor: Not established by the checked source; ask the contracting sender or DHL business unit.
claim_documents: No complete claim-document list verified in the checked source.
dhl_mx.insurance_note: No Mexico-specific coverage terms verified here; check whether value protection was purchased and the policy for this service.

fedex_mx.search_window: The checked domestic terms state no later than 21 business days after delivery or the estimated delivery date for a written claim; this is not a delivery guarantee and international services differ.
fedex_mx.search_actor: The sender/contracting customer should open the service request; confirm eligibility for the purchased service.
search_documents: Tracking/air waybill number; the official support page says it is also the tracking number.
fedex_mx.claim_window: Domestic: written claim within 21 business days after actual or estimated delivery. International terms differ; check the applicable service document.
fedex_mx.claim_actor: Customer/contract holder; the domestic terms require a written claim.
claim_documents: Information/documentation proving the contracted service and shipment characteristics
Keep packaging available for inspection
FedEx may request missing information within 5 business days under the domestic terms
fedex_mx.insurance_note: The domestic terms say FedEx does not provide insurance; declared-value options and other services have their own conditions. Verify the shipment contract; do not assume insurance.
fedex_mx.source_name: FedEx Mexico domestic terms and customer support

ups_us.search_window: No separate tracer deadline stated on the checked US claim page; check tracking and current UPS instructions.
ups_us.search_actor: Shipper or recipient checks tracking; a recipient may need the shipper if the shipper account restricts claims.
ups_us.claim_window: United States page: start a lost-package claim within 60 days of scheduled delivery. UPS says timeframes vary by country.
ups_us.claim_actor: Shipper or recipient/third-party may start a claim where the shipper account permits it; some shipper accounts restrict recipients.
claim_documents: Tracking number
Invoice/value record
Detailed goods description; UPS may request photos or inspection depending on claim
ups_us.insurance_note: Coverage and claim eligibility depend on service, declared value, contract, and account; use the claim page to confirm the shipment.

usps_us.search_window: USPS allows a Missing Mail search from 7 days through 365 days after mailing; it does not guarantee recovery.
usps_us.search_actor: Mailer or recipient can submit the search request; USPS asks for sender/recipient details.
search_documents: Detailed contents description and optional identifying photos
usps_us.claim_window: Domestic lost-article deadlines depend on service: common domestic services have no-earlier-than windows of 7 or 15 calendar days and a 60-day latest filing limit; see USPS Publication 122 for service-specific exceptions.
usps_us.claim_actor: Mailer or addressee for lost articles; eligibility depends on the service/insurance.
claim_documents: Proof of article value (for example, purchase receipt)
Evidence of insurance (for example, mailing receipt/label/tracking)
Keep mailpiece, labels, wrapping, packaging, and contents until resolved
usps_us.insurance_note: Some USPS products include insurance and some allow purchased insurance; only the actual eligible service/receipt determines coverage.
usps_us.source_name: USPS Missing Mail and Publication 122 Domestic Claims Guide

correos_mx.search_window: No single search window for all services is stated on the tracking page; registered and MEXPOST claim windows differ.
correos_mx.search_actor: Sender or recipient checks the tracking page; claim rights differ by service and party.
search_documents: Registered-mail or MEXPOST tracking/guide number and deposit receipt; verify the selected service.
correos_mx.claim_window: Official manual A4: registered mail may be claimed within 6 months from deposit; EMS/MEXPOST sender claim within 20 calendar days after the delivery period expires; MEXPOST recipient within 3 business days after that deadline.
correos_mx.claim_actor: Sender for registered/EMS timeframes; MEXPOST recipient has a separate 3-business-day window.
claim_documents: No universal attachment list is reproduced here; use the official claim portal and retain the guide, deposit receipt, and service record.
correos_mx.insurance_note: The manual describes Seguro Postal only for eligible registered/MEXPOST shipments that purchased it; verify the receipt and policy.
correos_mx.source_name: Correos de México claim portal and Manual DCC-PR-12-025 A4 (23 Dec 2025)

paquetexpress_mx.search_window: No separate tracer window verified; the tracking page accepts a guide/code/reference according to the FAQ.
paquetexpress_mx.search_actor: Sender or recipient may check shipment status; claim formalization is governed by the waybill/service contract.
search_documents: Tracking code, guide number, or reference.
paquetexpress_mx.claim_window: The checked waybill says the formal claim letter must arrive within 15 calendar days after the incident is recorded.
paquetexpress_mx.claim_actor: Sender or recipient, subject to the signed waybill/contract; the waybill requires a formal claim.
claim_documents: Formal claim letter
Cost/pre-existence proof for claimed goods where applicable
Other documents listed in the signed service request/waybill
paquetexpress_mx.insurance_note: Declared value or insurance coverage is conditional on the service/waybill; verify whether coverage was purchased and the listed insurer.

redpack_mx.search_window: No separate tracer deadline verified in the checked public terms.
redpack_mx.search_actor: Sender or recipient may check tracking; the terms assign claims to the consumer/contracting party.
search_documents: Tracking guide number; tracking page shows the shipment status.
redpack_mx.claim_window: Terms: claim in writing within 24 business hours after receipt or after a loss is confirmed. Redpack states the time limits for a service claim can depend on the contracted service.
redpack_mx.claim_actor: Consumer/contracting party; the terms direct a written claim to customer service.
claim_documents: The checked terms do not list a universal attachment set; retain guide/receipt and evidence, then confirm requirements with Redpack.
redpack_mx.insurance_note: No universal separate insurance coverage was verified in the checked terms; check the service/waybill.
redpack_mx.source_name: Redpack terms and conditions / tracking FAQ

99minutos_mx.search_window: The support FAQ says report a problem promptly and provide the guide/details; see the conflicting deadline note for claims.
99minutos_mx.search_actor: The sender/shipper should contact support; FAQ also allows a recipient to report a delivery issue.
search_documents: Photographs/evidence if applicable, per the support FAQ
99minutos_mx.claim_window: Public sources conflict: current FAQ says claims for packages over MXN 100 within 24 hours of incident; terms say 20 calendar days from collection for other reasons and 24 hours for loss below MXN 100. Verify the applicable service contract with 99minutos; no single deadline is asserted here.
99minutos_mx.claim_actor: Terms assign claims to the sender; support FAQ asks the reporter to email the incident and guide details.
claim_documents: Tracking guide
Incident details
Photographs/evidence when relevant; the exact claim file depends on the service contract
99minutos_mx.insurance_note: Coverage depends on service and declared-value/optional coverage terms; confirm the purchased contract.
99minutos_mx.source_name: 99minutos Terms and Conditions and customer support FAQ

ivoy_mx.search_window: The checked public support portal does not state a general search deadline.
ivoy_mx.search_actor: A customer/recipient may open the 'No recibí mi paquete' or status clarification request in the public portal.
search_documents: The checked portal describes a request for clarification/evidence when a delivery is marked delivered; no universal list was verified.
ivoy_mx.claim_window: No public claim deadline verified in the checked support portal.
ivoy_mx.claim_actor: Customer/recipient submits the portal request; the merchant may need to coordinate based on the store contract.
claim_documents: No universal claim-document list verified in the checked support portal.
ivoy_mx.insurance_note: No general insurance coverage verified; check the store/shipment contract and any separate policy.
